sql.workQueueType.getTypesForCompany: select id, company_id, work_queue_type, archived from flow.work_queue_type where company_id = :companyId and archived is not true order by work_queue_type
sql.workQueueType.getType: select id, company_id, work_queue_type, archived from flow.work_queue_type where id = :id
sql.workQueueType.deleteType: update flow.work_queue_type set archived = true where id = :id
sql.workQueueType.updateType: update flow.work_queue_type set work_queue_type = :workQueueType where id = :id
